advisories.title: ESP32 secure boot and flash encryption EMFI bypass

sparta_mappings.title: Disable/Bypass Encryption
sparta_mappings.mapping_basis: Analyst association: the manufacturer advisory documents bypass of Flash Encryption; SPARTA lists EX-0006 as Disable/Bypass Encryption. This is a threat mapping, not a compliance result.

advisories.description: Espressif advisory AR2023-005 describes an electromagnetic fault-injection technique affecting the classic ESP32. Its stated scenario uses Secure Boot V2 and Flash Encryption in Release mode with UART Download mode permanently disabled; it requires physical device access and sophisticated laboratory equipment. The advisory identifies chip revisions v3.0 and v3.1 and notes earlier revisions had a separate UART Download mode limitation.
conditions: Secure Boot V2 is enabled in Release mode
Flash Encryption is enabled in Release mode
UART Download mode is permanently disabled
The attacker has physical access and sophisticated EMFI equipment
mitigations: Review Espressif advisory AR2023-005 for the exact chip and product form factor.
Do not treat unknown chip revision or configuration as not affected.
Evaluate product-specific physical and operational mitigations with the manufacturer guidance.
